title: Define Cyclotron scoring dimensions
description: Define the scoring dimensions (real, useful/tangible, notable, novel, and others) and build the Cyclotron that scores candidate items on them. Dimension definitions are backend data.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: Real, Useful, Notable and Novel (1–5) are implemented as editor scores with rationales; hype gap = (Notable+Novel)/2 − (Real+Useful)/2.
